entries.original: A task child started as its own process no longer fails with `chain_not_held: timeout` when its engine takes longer than 10 s to boot, as on a cold Windows runner. ([#14808](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14808), fixes [#13165](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/13165))

entries.original: A script using the thread SDK (or `omo thread send`) can now message a session on another of your devices. Another device's engine accepts no command-line delivery from a different machine, so these sends answered `unsupported` (`sender_not_allowed`). entries.original: Concurrent `thread_read` calls of local terminals no longer fail together with `thread RPC request timed out`, `EPIPE` or `ECONNRESET` when another call in the same engine blocks its event loop (a cold remote read, for example). A local socket conversation's deadline now stops while the caller itself cannot run, and a read whose connection the terminal dropped during such a stall, before any response byte arrived, is dialed once more. Other commands are never retried. ([#14624](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14624), fixes [#14444](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/14444))

entries.original: Installing a newer omo no longer cuts running sessions off the thread tools. The binary that migrates the gateway store now records the oldest schema whose code can keep using it, and an older omo opens a newer store that meets it instead of answering `gateway_schema_too_new` on every call. Schemas 15 and 16 record floor 14, so a later omo that reads the floor keeps using them at schema 14. A newer store that an older omo cannot use is still refused with `gateway_schema_too_new`, also by a session that opened the store before the newer omo migrated it. omo 5.1.81 and older, schema 14 included, do not read the floor and still refuse any newer store once they reopen it, so this protects installs from this release on. ([#14622](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14622), fixes [#14382](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/issues/14382))

entries.original: Set `OMO_THREAD_READ_TRACE=1` in the caller to diagnose failed local read RPCs. The diagnostic reports the command, last socket phase, elapsed time, error code, how long the caller's own event loop was blocked and how many attempts were made, without printing addresses, credentials or transcript data. It is silent by default. A socket that connects without an auth exchange and fails before its request reports `connected`, not `handshake`. ([#14624](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14624), from [#14489](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14489) and [#14498](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent/pull/14498))
